    Evaluate the spread objective function without DEoptim

    runSpreadWithoutDEoptim.Rd

    In "debug" mode, runs fireSenseUtils::.objfunSpreadFit() once per parameter set, with plots. Otherwise calibrates the SNLL threshold: evaluates iterThresh random parameter sets with no early stop, in forked processes (drawn from the logistic's active range, see drawActivePars()), and returns pickThreshold() of their first-block SNLLs: thresholdMargin times the best trial that did not saturate.

    runSpreadWithoutDEoptim(
  iterThresh,
  lower,
  upper,
  fireSense_spreadFormula,
  flammableRTM,
  annualDTx1000,
  nonAnnualDTx1000,
  fireBufferedListDT,
  mutuallyExclusive = list(youngAge = "vegPC"),
  doObjFunAssertions = getOption("fireSenseUtils.assertions", TRUE),
  historicalFires,
  covMinMax,
  covCentre = NULL,
  objfunFireReps,
  maxFireSpread,
  weighted = TRUE,
  tests = c("snll_fs", "adtest"),
  formulaToFit,
  pars = NULL,
  plot.it = TRUE,
  mode = "fit",
  seed = NULL,
  escapeSizeHa = NULL,
  sizeLik = "kde",
  sizeLikDf = 5,
  adWeight = "auto",
  link = NULL,
  jumpTries = 0,
  jumpMeanDist = 0,
  yearAreaWeight = 0,
  areaDistWeight = 0,
  penaliseRunaways = TRUE,
  runawayEdgeFrac = fireSenseUtils::fireSenseRunawayEdgeFrac,
  runawayEdgeMin = fireSenseUtils::fireSenseRunawayEdgeMin,
  thresholdMargin = 2,
  maxDrawsPerTrial = 100
)

    Arguments

    iterThresh

    integer; number of random parameter sets.

    lower, upper

    numeric; bounds the random parameter sets are drawn between.

    fireSense_spreadFormula

    character; passed to FS_formula.

    flammableRTM

    SpatRaster; passed to landscape.

    annualDTx1000, nonAnnualDTx1000, fireBufferedListDT, historicalFires

    elements of the list made by fireSenseUtils::covsX1000AndSetDF().

    mutuallyExclusive

    named list of mutually exclusive covariates.

    doObjFunAssertions

    logical; passed to doAssertions.

    covMinMax

    data.table of covariate min and max, or NULL for no rescaling.

    covCentre

    named list of covariate centres (fireSenseUtils::spreadCovCentre()) subtracted from the rescaled covariates, as in the fit; NULL (no intercept) centres nothing. Passed to .objfunSpreadFit() and fireSenseUtils::spreadProbGates(), so the threshold is calibrated on the fit's objective.

    objfunFireReps

    integer; passed to Nreps, the replicates per fire.

    maxFireSpread

    numeric; upper limit on mean spread probability.

    weighted

    logical; weight the SNLL by log fire size. Also used in the rough threshold estimate.

    tests

    character; objective function tests, e.g. "SNLL_FS", "adTest".

    formulaToFit

    character; the spread formula.

    pars

    optional numeric vector, or list of them, to evaluate instead of random sets.

    plot.it

    passed to .objfunSpreadFit() in "debug" mode.

    mode

    character; if it includes "debug", the debug branch runs.

    seed

    integer or NULL; set.seed() value. NULL draws one at random.

    escapeSizeHa

    passed to .objfunSpreadFit(): fit escaped fires only (NULL: any fire over 1 pixel).

    sizeLik, sizeLikDf, adWeight, link, jumpTries, jumpMeanDist, yearAreaWeight, areaDistWeight, penaliseRunaways, runawayEdgeFrac, runawayEdgeMin

    passed to .objfunSpreadFit(), so the threshold is calibrated on the objective the fit uses. The defaults are that function's.

    thresholdMargin

    numeric; the threshold is this multiple of the best usable trial's first-block average annual SNLL (the unit of thresh in the objective).

    maxDrawsPerTrial

    integer; the calibration keeps only draws that pass the objective's spreadProb gates in the first block of years (fireSenseUtils::spreadProbGates()), until iterThresh are kept or maxDrawsPerTrial * iterThresh have been drawn. A constant of the function, not a module parameter. With none kept the result is NA (no early stop, see noEarlyStopThreshold()).

    Value

    the calibrated threshold (numeric, or NA if no trial was usable); NULL in "debug" mode.
